Name: Pig Mod
Author: KramplessHeaven
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/JDqvf2g.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]-> get a completely new, real-life based pigs while still being able to buy the base game ones!
-> male and female options - both male and female pigs give you truffles; male pigs cannot get pregnant but they give you more meat when slain.
-> [b]LANDRACE PIG[/b] is a common breed of pigs, a perfect replacement for the base game ones.
-> compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Digus' Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]﻿!
﻿-> for two mods to work together you have to have downloaded the Animal Husbandry Mod and the Pig Mod with the optional file
-> when slayed or exchanged for Pork the amount of meat you get depends on the gender and friendship level with the pig
-> give treats to your animals! Our pig likes the same treats the base game one does, so it's easy to remember
-> female pigs can get impregnated; all pigs can be chosen for the Animal Contest
-> keep your eyes peeled, because we're still working on new mods and updates!

[center]To install, extract the zip file and place the extracted folder in the mods folder of the game.
[steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods]

[i]MOD CREATED BY KRAMPLESSHEAVEN [art by Red, code by Blue][/i]

In case of any questions don't hesitate to contact us! If you like our work consider supporting us on Ko-fi, where you can become a part of our mod-making process!
